compositionRules: A recognizable bass or melodic identity, not merely a functional loop.
Interlocking syncopation between bass, percussion, vocal fragments, and tonal stabs.
Eight- and sixteen-bar phrase development with subtraction, response, fills, and timbral evolution.
A controlled mono low-end foundation surrounded by wider, moving mid/high layers.
Contrast between sparse tension spaces and dense club-payoff sections.
Organic or human source gestures processed into a psychedelic electronic frame.
rejectionRules: One static four-bar loop copied across the arrangement.
Every layer entering on the same downbeat and sustaining continuously.
A generic root-note bass with no articulation, syncopation, or call-and-response.
Brightness created only by adding hats or boosting highs.
Wide sub-bass, permanent full-spectrum pads, and reverb directly on low-frequency anchors.
Effects added as decoration without automation, routing intent, or section function.

generationContract.beforeWriting: Retrieve at least three compatible audio references, one producer/style document, and two relevant tutorial technique documents.
generationContract.composition: Derive a new motif grammar from interval, rhythm-slot, articulation, and phrase evidence; do not copy a copyrighted melody or reuse one source as a template.
generationContract.orchestration: Use only render-proven Ableton assets/devices and hosted plugins. Prefer real presets, racks, samples, grooves, and device chains over custom DSP.
generationContract.validation: Render, extract the same reference profile, compare stem balance/contrast/groove/timbre, inspect sparse and payoff sections separately, then revise the largest audible deltas.
